name: flux-priority
description: Ranks file records by how recently and how often they were touched.
notes:
Relevance ranker. Orders files by git activity -- each commit that touched a file adds 0.5 ** (age / 7 days), uncommitted and out-of-git files count their modified time once -- and emits them in priority order as Flux NDJSON.

`verbs` is empty ON PURPOSE, not yet-to-be-written. `.rank` was added (hsh 8ffaa9c) and removed again on 2026-07-05: flux-priority is orchestration-shaped -- it needs a curated JSON interest profile, a scoring worldview, and the context of 'hot with respect to what' -- while the f<verb> family is mechanical, stateless and neutral. Plain recency is reproducible with existing combinators: feye('.').p_jsonl().sort_by('modified').tail(N); the ranking by git activity (#27, 2026-10-10) is not. Interest is an injection port: --interest-profile multiplies activity, and whatever builds the profile lives outside this tool. Still a first-class pipe as a plain command: `flux-priority --since 24h`.
